# What did the adjuster's roof estimate leave out?

> Free roofing insurance supplement calculator: compare your measurement report with the adjuster's estimate, price missing drip edge, starter, steep-slope, waste and permit lines, add O&P, and see what the claim pays now and after depreciation. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
